description: ZEPY AI Secrets, Tokens, and Credential Signatures Database

signatures.title: Hardcoded OpenAI API Key Detected
signatures.remediation: Store OpenAI keys in environment variables (OPENAI_API_KEY) or secure key vaults. Revoke leaked keys immediately.

signatures.title: Hardcoded Anthropic API Key Detected
signatures.remediation: Store Anthropic keys in ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable. Revoke leaked credentials.

signatures.title: Hardcoded Google AI Studio / Gemini API Key Detected
signatures.remediation: Store Gemini keys in GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable and restrict key scopes in Google Cloud Console.

signatures.title: Hardcoded Hugging Face Token Detected
signatures.remediation: Store Hugging Face access tokens in HF_TOKEN env variable or use huggingface-cli login.

signatures.title: Hardcoded Cohere API Key Detected
signatures.remediation: Store Cohere keys in CO_API_KEY environment variable.

signatures.title: Hardcoded Mistral AI Key Detected
signatures.remediation: Store Mistral keys in MISTRAL_API_KEY environment variable.

signatures.title: Hardcoded Groq Cloud API Key Detected
signatures.remediation: Store Groq API keys in GROQ_API_KEY environment variable.

signatures.title: Hardcoded Together AI Key Detected
signatures.remediation: Store Together AI keys in TOGETHER_API_KEY environment variable.

signatures.title: Hardcoded Replicate API Token Detected
signatures.remediation: Store Replicate tokens in REPLICATE_API_TOKEN environment variable.

signatures.title: Hardcoded Pinecone Vector DB API Key Detected
signatures.remediation: Store Pinecone keys in PINECONE_API_KEY environment variable.

signatures.title: Hardcoded Qdrant Vector DB Key Detected
signatures.remediation: Store Qdrant keys in QDRANT_API_KEY environment variable.

signatures.title: Hardcoded Weaviate Vector DB Key Detected
signatures.remediation: Store Weaviate keys in WEAVIATE_API_KEY environment variable.

signatures.title: Hardcoded LangSmith API Key Detected
signatures.remediation: Store LangSmith keys in LANGCHAIN_API_KEY environment variable.

signatures.title: Hardcoded Weights & Biases API Key Detected
signatures.remediation: Use `wandb login` CLI or set WANDB_API_KEY in environment.

signatures.title: Hardcoded DeepSeek API Key Detected
signatures.remediation: Store DeepSeek keys in DEEPSEEK_API_KEY environment variable.
